content.short: Elixir is a modular liquidity network that provides algorithmic market-making for orderbook-based exchanges.
content.description: Elixir is a modular, decentralized liquidity network designed to power liquidity for orderbook-based exchanges across the Web3 ecosystem. It functions as a specialized infrastructure layer that allows users to provide liquidity to decentralized and centralized orderbooks using algorithmic market-making strategies. By democratizing access to market-making, Elixir enables retail participants to earn rewards while improving market depth and reducing spreads for all traders. The protocol's architecture is built for high performance and transparency, ensuring that liquidity is deployed effectively where it is needed most to support next-gen trading.
